decision: When no LLM is configured, advisor and evolve output Chronicle evidence + a synthesis request to stdout (exit 0) rather than erroring — the parent AI agent (Claude Code, Copilot, Codex) answers inline.
key_insight: When no LLM is configured, advisor and evolve output Chronicle evidence + a synthesis request to stdout (exit 0) rather than erroring — the parent AI agent (Claude Code, Copilot, Codex) answers inline.
alternatives_considered: Hard exit with error when no LLM found
rejected_reason: blocks usage in agent environments where the parent agent is the LLM
